source.license_note: Real upstream grpc-go optimization PR #6743; measured-speedup task.

task.summary: Speed up ValueFromIncomingContext so its case-insensitive key match no longer allocates a lowercased copy of every metadata key on each comparison, without changing behavior.
task.instructions: Optimize the metadata package for speed WITHOUT changing behavior. The benchmark BenchmarkValueFromIncomingContext/key-not-found measures it; existing tests must still pass.
task.acceptance_notes: Behavior preserved (go test passes); higher measured speedup is better. Do NOT edit any *_test.go.

code_fault.description: ValueFromIncomingContext does a case-insensitive key match by calling strings.ToLower(k) on every map key, allocating a new lowercased string per comparison on a hot lookup path.

ops_fault.description: Case-insensitive metadata key lookup in metadata/metadata.go calls strings.ToLower on each key while scanning the MD map, allocating per comparison instead of comparing in place.
detection_keywords: per-comparison string allocation in metadata lookup
repair_keywords: compare keys in place without lowercasing

visible_context.issue_text: Looking up a metadata value by key with ValueFromIncomingContext lowercases every key in the MD map to do a case-insensitive comparison, allocating on each comparison along a hot lookup path.
visible_context.notes: Real upstream optimization PR; the case-insensitive match is changed from strings.ToLower(k)==key to strings.EqualFold(k, key).
